links.context: for example, robert herrick was not a courtier, but his style marks him as a cavalier poet. cavalier works make use of allegory and classical allusions, and they are influenced by latin authors horace , cicero , and ovid . his religious epic poem paradise lost was published in 1667. john milton is one of the great english poets, who wrote at a time of religious flux and political upheaval.
